parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Procedure
• Take a piece of dialysis tubing. It is closed at one end with a knot.
• Rub gently at the end without the knot to open the tube.
• Using a syringe, carefully add 2 cm of iodine solution into the dialysis tubing.
• Tie the open end with a knot to enclose the iodine solution and make a bag.
• Thoroughly rinse the outside of the bag with water.
